title: Chassis Catalogue
description: Frame-scale vehicles a personnel-scale kid can crew, per design/scale-and-chassis.md. SF2E vehicle stat blocks (objects with Hardness/HP/Broken Threshold), NOT PC statblocks -- that's frame.schema.json's job, and hangar.schema.json's legacy units. Singleton file: data/campaign/chassis-catalogue.json. Every number here is transcribed from design/scale-and-chassis.md, not invented here -- that document is the source of truth for the maths; this file is its data form.

subtitle.description: The one-line flavor tag, e.g. "the sports car".

chassisLevel.description: Drives everything the Claimant interacts with: AC, saves, Hardness, HP, collision. Decoupled from Handling DC per design/scale-and-chassis.md §5, Deviation 1.

scalesWithFrameLevel.description: Decided 2026-08-22: chassis level automatically with Frames, 12->20, in lockstep. This file states level-12 (starting) values only; no per-level progression table exists yet.

price.description: Credits. Null for Directorate-issued stock with no meaningful purchase/loss from a player's economy (the Runabout).

acquisition.description: How a player actually gets this one -- issued at Kit Issue, requisitioned, found, negotiated, salvaged. See design/scale-and-chassis.md §13 open question 3-4 for the standing design question this answers per-chassis.

space.description: Free-text dimensions, e.g. "15 ft long, 8 ft wide, 5 ft high".

handlingDC.description: What the KID rolls (Piloting), decoupled from chassisLevel -- personnel-band DC per §5 Deviation 1.

reflex.description: Every Frame-scale chassis here lists Reflex, a deliberate deviation from RAW's 'typically only Fortitude' -- §5 Deviation 2.

vision.description: The fourth balancing axis (ideas/entries/vision-as-chassis-axis.json). Design intent only -- not yet verified against the real Foundry token vision/detection config.

damageStates.description: The shared four-stage curve from §8, identical for every chassis in this file -- included per-entry so a scene-runner reading this file doesn't have to also read the design doc to run it.

operational.const: 100-67% HP -- no penalty, Resonance/Handling governs as normal.

degraded.const: 66-34% HP -- -2 AC/saves, x3/4 Speed, capped at 2 actions regardless of Resonance band.

critical.const: 33-1% HP -- -4 AC/saves (matches RAW Broken), x1/2 Speed, x1/2 Hardness, capped at 1 action.
